fields.Intro Paragraph 1: In this conversation with Dr. Edith Ubuntu Chan, we explore blindfold vision, intuitive perception, and what happens when children are trained to trust their natural awareness instead of overriding it. This isn’t about party tricks or “superpowers,” it’s about restoring a baseline human capacity to know right from wrong. We get into how these abilities emerge, why they feel effortless when they’re working, and how overthinking blocks perception. Edith shares how she’s worked with families and children to develop these skills, and what it reveals about consciousness, education, and the future of human potential. If you’ve ever had moments of intuition that felt beyond your senses, or believe consciousness extends beyond the physical body, this conversation will resonate.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: Topics include blindfold vision and how it's taught, why kids learn this faster than adults, the role of flow state versus overthinking, intuition as a trainable skill, consciousness beyond the five senses, and a new model of learning and human development. In Part 2 we discuss the importance of departing from models (conventional and alternative) of childhood education, the incredible psychic abilities of undamaged children, and how personal energy mastery invokes consistent synchronicity.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Questions Before Curriculum", "body": "Edith's Luminous Education Revolution is an eighteen session self guided course that refuses to begin from Waldorf, Montessori or Reggio and instead sends parents and educators into deeper inquiry: what is a human being, what are we doing here, what is the purpose of parenthood and of education, how do you define intelligence, how does your family measure success, what do you actually value. Only once a family has worked through those does she let the conversation turn to skills, subjects and curriculum, which then arrive as a byproduct rather than as a template someone else designed."}, {"title": "The Soul That Negotiated His Arrival", "body": "After an eleven day dark room retreat in 2013 and a move to Sebastopol, a small visitor began turning up in Edith's dreams asking her to be his mother. In a hypnagogic state he showed her orbs of light strung together across the whole Earth, told her a generation was coming to blanket the planet with that energy, and said her refusal of both the authoritarian and the permissive parenting extremes was exactly right. Then he blanked the scene to black so she could feel the choice, and conception followed consciously not long after."}, {"title": "Discipline and Surrender in Balance", "body": "Her boy objected that he ate and used the bathroom when his body said so and not when the teacher announced snack time, and she watched the chopped up preschool schedule pull him out of the deep building projects he loved. Taking him out did not mean structurelessness. Signing up for a six week course and actually doing the assignments is itself a skill, and she frames the balance between discipline and surrender, structure and formlessness, masculine and feminine, as the real flow state training that all of education could be built around."}, {"title": "Where the Flow First Gets Interrupted", "body": "Chance brings his biofield tuning practice in as corroboration. When clients say creativity feels unreachable or flow feels impossible, he finds the stuck energy in the back left sacral region, and the expectation of being interrupted traces back again and again to the first serious separation from the mother, usually the start of school. The front of that same chakra ties satisfaction to the stomach, which is why nurture and nutrition share a root. He follows the thread out to the Prussian schooling model, built so that soldiers would keep following orders."}, {"title": "Radical Self Trust and Contagious Coherence", "body": "The belief that blocks creativity is standing at the blank canvas thinking I do not know what to do, and the cure is to ask how would I do this instead. Chance extends that permission all the way into parenting and warns that it will feel like making it up as you go, which is precisely what getting closer to truth feels like. Edith supplies the social half: whoever holds the most coherent field becomes the dominating energy of a room, so others click into their own flow, and her participants walk out into runs of synchronicity."}]
